literal_meaning: উপচে যাওয়া বা জট পাকানো অবস্থা
figurative_meaning_en: An unwanted mixture of various things
example_sentences_in_english: A tangle has formed in the corner of the room.
His words have become a jumbled mess.
note: Refers to a messy, undifferentiated blend often used in colloquial Bengali to describe chaos or poor organization.
